patterns: Only MGNREGA PYQs here: eligibility (adult members of any rural household) and A-R on 100 days with right to work not in Part III.
Typical traps: guarantee is per household not per individual; right to work is not a fundamental right.
APPSC elsewhere asks poverty-line committee figures (Rangarajan Rs 32/47) and PLFS as the unemployment standard.
App adds many committee/data/statement items; they are direct and sound, though some stems used odd 'stated figure' wording.
